summary: Supplies a previously approved draft task to produce its final video while reusing the draft's model, prompt, images, audio choice, seed, ratio, duration, and camera setting. BytePlus supports draft_task input only on Seedance 1.5 Pro, so it is unavailable on every model in this Seedance 2.x group.
combines: Anything not in that reused list can be set manually; unset parameters fall back to model defaults.
Two-step flow: create the draft with `draft: true`, then create the final task with `type: draft_task`.
